name: simpleshow
tagline: simpleshow uses AI to transform complex topics into simple, engaging explainer videos. Its Explainer Engine analyses scripts and automatically creates illustrated videos with a distinctive whiteboard animation style. Enterprise companies use it for training, change management, and product explainers across global teams.
